Tagged units changed only by the package move: identifiers re-qualified with bgpls., comments re-pointed; producer bodies byte-identical modulo the writeTLV->WriteTLV and field-export renames (TLV code constants verified unchanged). RFC 7752 Section 3.3.2.3: "If a source protocol uses a metric width of less than 32 bits, then the high-order bits of this field MUST be padded with zero." Proof is the IS-IS pair (TestRFC7752TEDefaultMetricWidenedWithZeroHighOrder 0a0b0c->000a0b0c, TestRFC7752TEDefaultMetricAllOnesNeverReachesHighOrder ffffff->00ffffff) over the real producer isis bgpls_export. The plugin ls unit TestRFC7752TEDefaultMetricZeroPadded proves nothing about emitted bytes: lsTEDefaultMetric is constructed only by its decoder and its WriteTo has no non-test caller; it is supplementary and earns no credit.
